item.description: Ladan Salihu, a Nigerian broadcaster and former director-general of the Federal Radio Corporation of Nigeria (FRCN), says the US air strike on Christmas night in Jabo village, Sokoto state, missed its intended target and lacked precision. item.title: Tyre burst kills 11, leaves 9 injured in Jigawa crash
item.description: The Jigawa State Police Command has confirmed a deadly road accident that claimed 11 lives and left nine others injured.The crash happened on Thursday, December 25, 2025, around 4:30pm at Bagewu village in Ringim Local Government Area. item.title: Police arrest ‘bandits’ seen in viral video flaunting arms, cash
item.description: The Nigeria Police Force (NPF) has announced the arrest of two suspected bandits involved in killings and kidnappings across Katsina, Zamfara, Niger, and Kwara states. One of the suspects was identified as Abubakar Usman, popularly known as Siddi, who was seen in a viral video flaunting arms and large sums of money. item.description: Niyi Akinmolayan is the latest producer to accuse Nigerian cinemas of sabotaging December film releases through unfair screening practices. item.title: Seyi Tinubu, wife conferred with chieftaincy titles in Lagos days after Oyo honour
item.description: Seyi Tinubu, son of President Bola Tinubu, and his wife, Layal, have been installed with chieftaincy titles in Lagos state. The ceremony follows closely on the heels of a similar royal honour conferred upon the couple in Oyo just days prior. item.description: Residents of Tangaza Local Government Area of Sokoto State have confirmed aerial attacks on locations believed to be hideouts of the Lakurawa armed group in the area. item.title: US airstrikes didn’t infringe on Nigeria’s sovereignty – Foreign Affairs Minister Tuggar
item.description: The Minister of Foreign Affairs, Yusuf Tuggar, says the United States military airstrikes in parts of the North-West did not violate Nigeria’s sovereignty or territorial integrity. Tuggar maintained this stance on Friday in an interview with the CNN, stressing that the operation was fully authorised by the Federal Government. item.title: New Tax Reforms to Take Effect January 1, 2026 — Oyedele
item.description: The chairman of the Presidential Fiscal Policy and Tax Reforms Committee, Taiwo Oyedele, has reaffirmed that the implementation of the new tax reforms will commence on January 1, 2026. Oyedele assured that the reforms under the new tax laws are intended to provide relief to Nigerians and stimulate economic growth.
